test_title: PYST 39 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'UPEND' is coded as 'AJBLR' and 'AUDIT' is coded as 'QEAQX'. How will 'AIMED' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56642b877e5cb3ec40ac8d2da0a05474d0dd26bc5d32323a5039231b2b77658c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'UPEND' is coded as 'AJBLR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8bc73045720d3ac3133e8fea762e439e13322a0c20abb924d46ba942ebe1c31.png] 

'AUDIT' is coded as 'QEAQX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14111f213464d3c9f8d8204020eb9c74d6dffb020ffbcf33451fefe8d7350da8.png] 

Similarly, for AIMED:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e357da8d0bf0cf381f3f4d221f3a35673b29b1a5310b0640307a363b35b9ffa6.png] 

So, 'AIMED' is coded as 'AAJEX'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
